name: The Legend of Ogorets #2: Tsundere
source:
#2 is the adventure of Tsundere, a winter sprite known for bringing Christmas, a one-time occasion of snowfall every thirteen years, who has just been shot down by an evil entity from beyond the boundary of post-civilization. The unlucky sprite becomes embroiled in a conflict she must chronicle in exchange for safe passage out of bone-caked ruins.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536310/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
#2是傲娇的冒险，她是一位冬季精灵，以带来圣诞节而闻名，圣诞节每十三年降雪一次，她刚刚被来自后文明边界之外的邪恶实体击落。不幸的精灵卷入了一场冲突，她必须记录下来，以换取安全离开白骨废墟的机会。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536310/]Steam[/url]]
